sentences.en: CATHY: OK, Graham, so let's check we both know what we're supposed to be doing.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 好的，格雷厄姆，我们先确认一下双方都清楚自己该做什么。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: OK.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 好的。

sentences.en: CATHY: So, for the university's open day, we have to plan a display on British life and literature in the mid-19th century.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 所以，为大学的开放日，我们需要策划一场关于19世纪中期英国生活与文学的展览。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: That's right.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 没错。

sentences.en: But we'll have some people to help us find the materials and set it up, remember - for the moment, we just need to plan it.
sentences.zh: 但我们会有专人协助我们搜集资料并布置展台，别忘了——目前我们只需完成策划工作。

sentences.en: CATHY: Good.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 很好。

sentences.en: So have you gathered who's expected to come and see the display?
sentences.zh: 那么，你已弄清预计有哪些人会来参观这个展览了吗？

sentences.en: Is it for the people studying English, or students from other departments?
sentences.zh: 这是专为英语专业学生举办的，还是面向其他院系的学生？

sentences.en: I'm not clear about it.
sentences.zh: 我对这一点还不太明确。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Nor me.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 我也不清楚。

sentences.en: That was how it used to be, but it didn't attract many people, so this year it's going to be part of an open day, to raise the university's profile.
sentences.zh: 过去确实是那样安排的，但吸引不了多少人；因此今年它将作为开放日的一部分，以提升大学的知名度。

sentences.en: It'll be / publicised in the city, to encourage people to come and find out something of what goes on here.
sentences.zh: 活动将在本市进行宣传，鼓励公众前来了解本校的日常教学与研究情况。

sentences.en: And it's included in the information that's sent to people who / are considering applying to study here next year.
sentences.zh: 同时，相关信息也会随招生简章一并寄送给那些正在考虑明年申请入读本校的人士。

sentences.en: CATHY: Presumably some current students and lecturers will come?
sentences.zh: CATHY: 想必一些在校学生和讲师也会来参观吧？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: would imagine so, but we've been told to concentrate on the other categories of people.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 我想应该会，不过我们被告知应重点关注其他几类人群。

sentences.en: CATHY: Right.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 明白了。

sentences.en: We don't have to cover the whole range of 19th-century literature, do we?
sentences.zh: 我们不必涵盖整个19世纪文学的全部范畴，对吧？

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: GRAHAM: No, it's entirely up to us.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 不必，完全由我们自行决定。

sentences.en: I suggest just using Charles Dickens.
sentences.zh: 我建议只聚焦查尔斯·狄更斯的作品。

sentences.en: CATHY: That's a good idea.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 这是个好主意。

sentences.en: Most people have heard of him, and have probably read / some of his novels, or seen films based on them, so that's a good lead-in to life in his time.
sentences.zh: 大多数人至少听说过他，可能还读过他的一些小说，或看过根据其作品改编的电影，因此这能很好地引出他所处时代的社会生活。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Exactly.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And his novels show the awful conditions that most people had to live in. /
sentences.zh: 而且他的小说展现了当时绝大多数人所面临的恶劣生存状况。

sentences.en: don't they: he wanted to shock people into doing something about it.
sentences.zh: 不是吗？他写作的目的正是要震撼读者，促使人们采取行动改善现状。

sentences.en: CATHY: Did he do any campaigning, other than writing?
sentences.zh: CATHY: 除了写作之外，他是否还从事过其他形式的社会倡导活动？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Yes, he campaigned for education and other social reforms, and gave talks, but I'm inclined to ignore that and focus on the novels.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 是的，他积极倡导教育及其他社会改革，并举办过多次公开演讲；但我倾向于忽略这部分内容，而专注于他的小说。

sentences.en: CATHY: Yes, I agree.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: CATHY: OK, so now shall we think about a topic linked to each novel?
sentences.zh: CATHY: 好的，那我们现在来想想每部小说可关联的主题吧？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Yes.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 好的。

sentences.en: I've printed out a list of Dickens's novels in the order they were in published, in the hope you'd agree to focus on him!
sentences.zh: 我已打印出狄更斯小说按出版时间顺序排列的清单，希望你能同意以他为焦点！

sentences.en: CATHY: You're lucky I did agree!
sentences.zh: CATHY: 你真幸运，我确实同意了！

sentences.en: Let's have a look.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看。

sentences.en: OK, the first was The Pickwick Papers, published in 1836.
sentences.zh: 好的，第一部是1836年出版的《匹克威克外传》。

sentences.en: It was very successful when it came out, wasn't it, and was adapted for the theatre straight away.
sentences.zh: 它刚问世时非常成功，对吧？而且很快就被改编成了戏剧。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: There's an interesting point, though, that there's a character who keeps falling asleep, and that medical condition was named after the book - Pickwickian Syndrome.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 不过这里有个有趣的点：书中有个角色总爱打瞌睡，而这种医学病症后来就以该书命名为‘匹克威克综合征’。

sentences.en: CATHY: Oh, so why don't we use that as the topic, and include some quotations from the novel?
sentences.zh: CATHY: 哦，那我们何不就用这个作为主题，并在展览中加入一些小说中的引文呢？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Right.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 好主意。

sentences.en: Next is Oliver Twist.
sentences.zh: 接下来是《雾都孤儿》。

sentences.en: There's a lot in the novel about poverty.
sentences.zh: 这部小说中有大量关于贫困的描写。

sentences.en: But maybe something less obvious
sentences.zh: 但也许可以选一些不那么明显的东西。

sentences.en: CATHY: is Well Oliver is taught how to steal, isn't he?
sentences.zh: CATHY: 嗯，奥利弗是被教着去偷东西的，对吧？

sentences.en: We could use that to illustrate the fact that very few children went to school. particularly not poor children, so they learnt in other ways.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用这个来说明当时很少有孩子上学，尤其是贫困家庭的孩子，因此他们通过其他方式学习。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Good idea.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 好主意。

sentences.en: What's next?
sentences.zh: 接下来是什么？

sentences.en: CATHY: Maybe Nicholas Nickleby.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 也许可以选《尼古拉斯·尼克尔贝》。

sentences.en: Actually he taught in a really cruel school, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 实际上，他曾在一所极其残酷的学校里任教，对吧？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: That's right.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 没错。

sentences.en: But there's also the company of touring actors that Nicholas joins.
sentences.zh: 但尼古拉斯后来还加入了一个巡回演出的剧团。

sentences.en: We could do something on theatres and other amusements of the time.
sentences.zh: 我们可以围绕当时的剧院及其他娱乐活动做些内容。

sentences.en: We don't want only the bad things, do we?
sentences.zh: 我们总不能只讲那些负面的东西吧，对吗？

sentences.en: CATHY: OK.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 好的。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: What about Martin Chuzzlewit?
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 那《马丁·朱泽尔威特》呢？

sentences.en: He goes to the USA, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他去了美国，对吧？

sentences.en: CATHY: Yes, and Dickens himself had been there a year before, and drew on his experience there in the novel.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 是的，而且狄更斯本人此前一年刚去过美国，并在小说中借鉴了那里的经历。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: I wonder, though ...
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 不过，我有点好奇……

sentences.en: The main theme is selfishness, so we could do something on social justice?
sentences.zh: 小说的主旨是自私，所以我们可以围绕社会正义展开？

sentences.en: No, too general, let's keep to your idea - I think it would work well.
sentences.zh: 不，太宽泛了，还是坚持你的想法吧——我觉得这个点子效果会很好。

sentences.en: CATHY: He wrote Bleak House next - that's my favourite of his novels.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 他接下来写的是《荒凉山庄》——这是我最喜爱的他的小说。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Yes, mine too.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 是啊，也是我最喜欢的。

sentences.en: His satire of the legal system is pretty powerful.
sentences.zh: 他对司法体系的讽刺相当犀利。

sentences.en: CATHY: That's true, but think about Esther, the heroine.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 的确如此，但想想女主角埃丝特。

sentences.en: As a child she lives with someone she doesn't know is her aunt, who treats her very badly.
sentences.zh: 她小时候和一位她并不知道其实是自己姨妈的人生活在一起，而这位姨妈对她非常恶劣。

sentences.en: Then she's very happy_ living with her guardian, and he puts her in charge of the household.
sentences.zh: 后来她与监护人一起生活得非常幸福，监护人还让她掌管整个家庭事务。

sentences.en: And at the end she gets married and her guardian gives her and her husband a house, where of course they're very happy.
sentences.zh: 最后她结婚了，监护人送给她和丈夫一栋房子，他们当然过得非常幸福。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Yes, I like that.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 是的，我很喜欢这部分。

sentences.en: CATHY: What shall we take next?
sentences.zh: CATHY: 接下来我们选哪一部？

sentences.en: Little Dorrit?
sentences.zh: 《小杜丽》？

sentences.en: Old Mr Dorrit has been in a debtors' prison for years ...
sentences.zh: 老杜丽先生已在债务人监狱里关押多年……

sentences.en: GRAHAM: So was Dickens's father, wasn't he?
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 狄更斯的父亲也曾坐过牢，对吧？

sentences.en: CATHY: That's right.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 没错。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: What about focusing on the part when Mr Dorrit inherits a fortune, and he starts pretending he's always been rich?
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 那么，我们是否可以聚焦于杜丽先生继承了一大笔财富后，开始假装自己一直都很富有这一情节？

sentences.en: CATHY: Good idea.
sentences.zh: CATHY: 好主意。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: OK, so next we need to think about what materials we want to illustrate each issue.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 好的，接下来我们需要思考每项议题需要哪些材料来加以说明。

sentences.en: That's going to be to quite hard.
sentences.zh: 这将会相当困难。
